items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: So I stayed home and I continued playing with the Charley Brantley's band.

ctx.x: So I stayed home and I continued playing with the Charley Brantley's band. So we got another piano player from--a boy came from Detroit. And so I--we played with that band until we got tired of that. And Johnny Burdine and myself, we decided to move on down to Miami, you know. Big time lifetime stuff--you know, the New York and the Florida, you know. So we moved on down there to Miami. We had a job down there working with another constituent of ours from Tampa. His name was Reuben Phillips. Reuben Phillips, not…

this boy was--he worked in the, he worked in the funeral home, you know. So he got tired of doing that. So we all went down there and we got a job working in a night club called The Entertainers Club. You know, it was like a horseshoe bar.
